en: A colorized vintage view of a wide open square or drill ground bordered by rows of trees, with scattered pedestrians in dark clothing. Behind the trees rises a hillside town with multiple light‑colored buildings and villas, set against a large mountain in the background. The lower white margin contains red printed Italian text identifying the location, and small publisher information in the bottom left corner.
